{{include reference="Mesures.Code.MesureMacros"/}}
{{velocity wiki="false"}} ## JSON for the Word and PowerPoint export of one measure sheet (KTD18), fetched by the export service with the ## reader's own session: /bin/get/Mesures/Code/ExportData?xpage=plain&outputSyntax=plain&mesure=Mesures.A.Secteur.M-0042 ## XWiki checks rights on this page, not on the sheet named in the parameter, so the view right is checked here. A ## sheet outside Mesures, one the reader cannot view, a missing page and a page without a measure object all get the ## same 404, which reveals nothing about which sheets exist. #set ($sheetRef = $NULL) #if ("$!request.mesure" != '') #set ($sheetRef = $services.model.resolveDocument($request.mesure)) #end #set ($sheetDoc = $NULL) #if ($sheetRef && $sheetRef.spaceReferences.size() == 3 && $sheetRef.spaceReferences.get(0).name == 'Mesures' && $services.security.authorization.hasAccess('view', $sheetRef) && $xwiki.exists($sheetRef)) #set ($sheetDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($sheetRef)) #end #set ($mesureObj = $sheetDoc.getObject('Mesures.Code.MesureClass')) #if (!$mesureObj) #set ($discard = $response.setStatus(404)) #set ($discard = $response.setContentType('application/json')) {"error":"not found"}## #else #mesurePlace ($sheetDoc $place) #mesureBureaux ($bureaux) #set ($mesureClass = $xwiki.getClass('Mesures.Code.MesureClass')) #set ($provenanceClass = $xwiki.getClass('Mesures.Code.ProvenanceClass')) #set ($fields = []) #foreach ($field in ['cleSource', 'dateCreation', 'vecteurJuridique', 'raisonEtre', 'modalitesModification', 'documentationInterne', 'documentationExterne']) ## Rendered by the sheet's own display(), so rich text runs with the sheet author's rights, never this page's. #set ($displayed = $sheetDoc.display($field, 'view', $mesureObj)) #set ($displayed = $displayed.replaceAll('^\{\{html[^}]*\}\}', '').replaceAll('\{\{/html\s*\}\}$', '').trim()) #set ($discard = $fields.add({'name': $field, 'label': $mesureClass.get($field).prettyName, 'html': $displayed})) #end #set ($provenances = []) #foreach ($provenance in $sheetDoc.getObjects('Mesures.Code.ProvenanceClass')) #set ($fiche = $stringtool.trim("$!provenance.getValue('ficheAnnuaire')")) #set ($ficheUrl = '') #if ($fiche != '') #set ($ficheRef = $services.model.resolveDocument($fiche)) #if ($xwiki.exists($ficheRef)) #set ($ficheUrl = $xwiki.getURL($ficheRef)) #end #end #set ($frequence = $sheetDoc.display('frequence', 'view', $provenance)) #set ($frequence = $frequence.replaceAll('^\{\{html[^}]*\}\}', '').replaceAll('\{\{/html\s*\}\}$', '').trim()) #set ($discard = $provenances.add({ 'donnee': "$!provenance.getValue('donnee')", 'emetteur': "$!provenance.getValue('emetteur')", 'emetteurUrl': $ficheUrl, 'frequence': $frequence, 'format': "$!provenance.getValue('format')", 'contact': "$!provenance.getValue('contact')" })) #end #set ($bureau = $bureaux.get($place.bureau)) #set ($discard = $response.setContentType('application/json')) $jsontool.serialize({ 'identifier': $sheetRef.name, 'title': $sheetDoc.plainTitle, 'url': $xwiki.getURL($sheetRef), 'bureau': {'code': $place.bureau, 'name': "$!bureau.name"}, 'perimetre': {'code': $place.perimetre, 'label': $mesurePerimetres.get($place.perimetre)}, 'fields': $fields, 'provenances': $provenances, 'lastModified': {'date': $xwiki.formatDate($sheetDoc.date, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), 'author': $xwiki.getPlainUserName($sheetDoc.authorReference)} })## #end {{/velocity}}
